primary_location_source.citation: Berger, Hamilton, Singer, Waddell, Churchill, Leben, Lee and Sturges (2000), DeSoto Canyon Eddy Intrusion Study, Final Report, Volume II: Technical Report, OCS Study MMS 2000-080, November 2000.
primary_location_source.locator: Section 5.4 discussion of the March 1997 survey and the 24 March 1997 SST image; first of two warm-eddy centers.

source_case_association: The original report explicitly names Deviant / LC ring D at 28 N,88.7 W on the 24 March 1997 SST image. The independently selected gridded peak is about 33.17 km away. This is a qualified same-name/date/spatial source-case reference, not a verified physical registry crosswalk or reproduction of the SST boundary.
method_interpretation: Select a unique sampled height maximum within the declared search region; calculate native-grid geostrophic velocities; find the unique maximum perimeter-averaged speed over supported single-maximum closed contours; compare 0.005 and 0.0025 m peak-relative level steps. Speed-contour area/radius/bounding arcs refer to the dynamical core, not the full outer eddy.
development_and_transfer: Deviant was already inspected and is a development case. Kraken has an independently documented dated source-map interior point and passes the same algorithm and convergence checks; it is a transfer check, not blind validation or a numerical calibration target. No new Kraken reference is admitted here.

rounding_rule.meaning: Fixed outward reporting increments for both level-step results; not physical uncertainty, source accuracy or seasonal extrema.

limitations: Search point and peak differ; source latitude is coarsely reported and source positional error is unknown.
150 km association tolerance and minimum 12 interior gridpoints are OSW rules, not source accuracy or effective-resolution claims.
The native 0.125 degree grid and two level-step results do not establish physical boundary uncertainty. Mapping, MDT, derivative, interpolation and physical-front errors remain unquantified.
The input is native ADT. A legacy frozen-operator key was renamed by this caller to peak_input_height_m; all numeric profiles are unchanged from the first passing run.
No local current maximum, direct ADCP observation, outer radius, principal width, material boundary, whole-life extrema or seasonal cycle inferred.
Source dates, registry separation on 1996-12-13 and later dissipation remain distinct. No primary/secondary or neighboring-feature measurement inheritance.
